entities.name: Mohammad Boroujerdi

entities.summary: Mohammad Boroujerdi was an Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps commander during the Iran–Iraq War. He played key roles in regaining control over the territories of Kurdistan by Iranian forces.
